name: web-minimalist-furniture-hero-with-mint-panel-and-trust-stats
title: 'Minimalist Furniture' hero with a sofa breaking out of a mint panel and a trust-stats bar
whatItIs: A warm off-white hero with a small mint eyebrow, a bold two-line 'Minimalist Furniture' headline, a mint 'Learn More' button and 'Our Story' play link, a grey sofa overlapping a tall mint panel labelled '01. a perfect sofa' with yellow dots, and a bottom bar with '30 days', 'Customer', 'Free Shipping'.
whatItMeans: Calm and trustworthy; the product breaking out of its panel adds depth to a simple layout.
techniques: Let the product overlap out of a colour panel.
Number the featured product like a collection.
Close the hero with a row of trust stats.
Pair a solid CTA with a play-icon text link.

vocabulary.definition: An image extending past its container.
A row of guarantees or stats.
